content: Kogu a kanomoꞌa ofalinimo maleꞌniya kavafeꞌmo huꞌniya gemae
Yesuꞌa Yu vayaꞌai alopa mono nopiꞌmo maiꞌnenoꞌaeꞌmo alino maku huno apakeyana kagemi yaꞌapimo haneꞌniya vayaꞌmogi ofalini monimo fiku neꞌatalaya kesifiꞌmo maleꞌnageno apakeꞌniye.
Mago kogu a kanomo kagemi yaꞌamo alagi oꞌmaleꞌniya a kanomoꞌa eno lole asagalifa monimo maleꞌnigeno agetenoꞌaeꞌmo,
lama gemo lapa nepauve, ani kagemi yaꞌamo oꞌmaleꞌniya kogu aꞌmoꞌa maleꞌniya ofalinimoꞌa muki vayaꞌmogi maleꞌnaya ofalini monimo ago aeno aga seꞌniye.
Kagemi yaꞌapimo haneꞌniya vayaꞌmogi aliꞌyaꞌamo ohaneꞌniya monimo maleꞌnayaꞌmonanafa kogu a kanomoꞌa muki moniꞌamo neꞌyaꞌamo miya faino nesiya moniꞌeꞌmo ago maleꞌniye, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Yesuꞌa alopa mono noꞌmo heꞌa halagape vaigae, huno huꞌniya gemae
Mago vayaꞌmo geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌmogi, alagepa yafaꞌaletikeꞌmo ki maleteꞌa ofalini neꞌmalaya konali yatetiꞌmo aliꞌa hu maleꞌnaya kanale noꞌmo haneꞌniye, huꞌa huꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo,
hemenimo ageꞌnaya noteꞌmo haneꞌniya yafaꞌmo akalo akalo huno haneꞌniyana muki yafaꞌamo aliꞌa halagape vaiꞌa aliꞌa atagu faeꞌa atalegae, huno hapa paiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo,
Tisao, hainu afinaꞌmo ani kavaꞌmo afole aigiye. Hogoteta na agufa alagena kavaꞌmo agetesunagenoꞌaeꞌmo afole aigiye, huꞌa afi geꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo,

humi olapatesayafeꞌmo ehetapiye. Alagepa hutapa yagaiyo. Asole vayaꞌmogi eꞌa nagiꞌnimo aeteꞌapaeꞌmo, Kalaisi vekamo maiꞌnove, huꞌa huge, ani afinaꞌmo ago afole aiꞌniye, huꞌa huge hisagetapaeꞌmo apakame osiyo.

Mago vayaꞌmogi kame nehisaya kavafeꞌmo apava gemo huliꞌa ege lusi kaveta hisaya kavafeꞌmo apava gemo huliꞌa ege hisagetapaeꞌmo koli osiyo. Ani agufa kavakoꞌmo hogoteno afole aisigetapaeꞌmo hemenimo alagi ago hano hisiya afinaꞌmo hogo nehiye, hutapa osiyo.
Mago nofi vayaꞌmogi alu nofi vayaꞌmo kame hapaege mago gamani vayaꞌmogi alu gamani vayaꞌaina kame hapaege hugae.

Muki aupilagamo lusi imimaꞌmo alige kafu hu kavaꞌmo afole aige kaita hapau kavaꞌmoꞌa aino atagu faeno uneno hisigeꞌapaeꞌmo asole vayaꞌmo lusi kaitaꞌmo hapauge hugiye. Kokuꞌnate alagena kavaꞌmo ageteꞌapaeꞌmo lusi kava huꞌa koli hugae.

Ani kavaꞌmo afole oꞌaiꞌnisigeꞌapaeꞌmo hogoteꞌa apaini huꞌa lapatege kalavusi huꞌa lapatege mono nokopiꞌmo agoti huꞌa lapateteꞌa kalavusi huꞌa lapatege hugae. Apakaemo nagiꞌnilefeꞌmo lapavaleli eꞌa alaꞌapimo yagaiꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌaitegaꞌe gamani vayaꞌaitegaꞌeꞌmo aliꞌa he tiꞌa lapatesagetapaeꞌmo nagae nava gemo faigoko geꞌnimo hapa paigae.
Lapakaemo hogotetapa lapakesa afitapaeꞌmo nagaemo geꞌapileꞌmo na agufa gemo aeꞌna atagaina huꞌna hapa paiguve, hutapa lapakesa oꞌafiyo.
Nagaiꞌnimo alagepa huꞌa afiteꞌa ageꞌnaya gemo aliꞌna lapamisugetapa hapa paisageꞌa afiteꞌapaeꞌmo getapileꞌmo afaꞌa huꞌa aeꞌa ati kaeꞌa ge osugae.
Itatapi afotapimogimo lapavaleliꞌa uge konagatapimogi lapavaleliꞌa uge vayatapimogi lapavaleliꞌa uge huꞌa lapavaleli uꞌa agoti huꞌa lapatesageꞌapaeꞌmo mago vayaꞌamogi lapakaemo lapaesagetapa faligae.
Nakame nehayaꞌmofeꞌmo muki vayaꞌmogi apaini huꞌa lapategayaꞌmonanafa
alagepa hutapa maisageno magoke lapayokaꞌmo lageso osugiye.
Lapakaemo alagepa kateꞌmo oꞌataletapa lokiya vaitapa maisayana maige maige hutapa maisaya yaꞌmo aligae.
Yesuꞌa, Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo lusi hanageke yaꞌmo afole aigiye, huno huꞌniya gemae

Lapakaemo apakesageꞌapaeꞌmo ati vayaꞌmo eꞌa Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo faiꞌa ku aisagetapa apaketetapaeꞌmo, muki ani taonifiꞌmo maiꞌnaya vayaꞌmo hapaeꞌa hano huꞌa apatalesaya afinaꞌmo alagi hogo hiye, hutapa lapakesa afiyo.

Ani afinaꞌmo Yutiya kotega maiꞌnisaya vayaꞌmo apaune hetaleꞌa avelegamo haiyo. Alopa taonifiꞌmo maiꞌnisaya vayaꞌmo ataleꞌa apaune heꞌa viyo. Malaga maiꞌnisaya vayaꞌmogimo Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo ohaiyo.
Goti mukufiꞌmo avoꞌmo kae maleꞌnaya gemo afole aisiyafeꞌmo Gotiꞌa ani afinaꞌmo anonaꞌapilefeꞌmo lusi kayoꞌmo apamigiye.
Gotiꞌa ani vayaꞌaifeꞌmo aipamo leno apateteno apakafu kisiya kayoꞌmo apamigiyaꞌmofeꞌmo vaehae, apaipaguꞌe maiꞌnisaya aꞌneꞌe mafaꞌnemo nu neꞌapamisaya aꞌneꞌefeꞌmo nahau huꞌna neꞌapatove.

Ati vayaꞌmogimo mago vayaꞌamo naipeletiꞌmo lugoꞌapimo heꞌa hatagauteꞌa mago vayaꞌamo kalavusi huꞌa apateteꞌa muki nofi vayaꞌaitegamo apavaleli uꞌa apategae. Alu nofi vayaꞌmogimo eꞌa Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo kame huteꞌa aliꞌa hosu huꞌa ateme ateme neꞌvisageno kanaꞌapimo alagi hano hugiye.

Kokuꞌnapiꞌmo alagena kavaꞌmo yege lenagi kai lenagi kanefi tenagi huno aeto aeto agufa kavaꞌmo afole aigiye. Solovala aniꞌmoꞌa aino holakau holakau huno uneno nehisigeꞌapaeꞌmo muki kotegamo maiꞌnaya vayaꞌmogi haiya kava hisune, huꞌa huteꞌa lusi kava huꞌa koli hugae.
Kokuꞌnapi maiꞌnaya apaune vayaꞌmo lokiyaꞌapimo aino atagu faisigeꞌapaeꞌmo, na agufa kavaꞌmo ma mopafiꞌmo afole aigefe nehifi, huꞌa apakesa afiteꞌapaeꞌmo faliꞌnaya vayakana huꞌa maigae.
Ani kavaꞌmo hutesigenoꞌaeꞌmo Vemo Mafaꞌnemoꞌa hiyateꞌmo himamuꞌaꞌe lusi ha le konali yaꞌaꞌeꞌmo eminesigeꞌa agegae.
Ani kavaꞌmo aepa faino afole aisigetapaeꞌmo hatu maeno lapatesiya afinaꞌmo alagi hogo hugiyaꞌmofeꞌmo alita maku hutapa agetetapaeꞌmo lapamogaga aiyo.
Agaemo aeno kalafefa gemo huno hapa painoꞌaeꞌmo, lapakaemo fiki yosaꞌe muki alu yosaleꞌeꞌmo ageyo.
Saufa anupamo malegetapa agetetapaeꞌmo, koꞌmo neꞌaiya afinaꞌmo alagi hogo hiye, hutapa nehae.
Ani kava huno ani kavaꞌmo afole aisigetapa agetetapaeꞌmo, Gotiꞌa yagaino apatesiya afinaꞌmo alagi ago hogo hiye, hutapa hugae.
Lama gemo lapa nepauve, hemeni afinaꞌmo maiꞌnisaya vayaꞌmo ofaliꞌa afaꞌa maiꞌnisageno muki ani agufa kavaꞌmo afole aigiye.
Kokuꞌnaꞌe ma mopaꞌeꞌmo hano hugiyaꞌmonanafa geꞌnimo alagi hano osuno afaꞌa hanege hanege huno hanegaiye.

Lapakaitapileꞌmo alagepa huta yagaitapa lapateyo. Fiku yanagetapa lusi yagita huge lokiya aniꞌmo netetapa negi nagi gemo huge ma mopafi yafeꞌmo lapakesa alaꞌamo afige lapausoli huge nehisageno mani afinaꞌmo malage huno kesi katetiꞌmo afole aigiye.
Ma mopafi muki haopalegamo maiꞌnaya vayaꞌaitegamo aneꞌaiꞌmoꞌa yagagafamo neꞌatafaiya agufa kavakana huno apatafaugiye.
Inagi muki afinaꞌmo kava yagaitapa maiyo. Muki afole aisiya kavaꞌamo aetapa kasalo paetapa Vemo Mafaꞌnemo aulagaleꞌmo he titapa maisayafeꞌmo nunumu hiyo, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Muki afinaꞌae afinaꞌaeꞌmo alopa mono nopiꞌmo alino apaya malege malege huno maiꞌnigeno haniꞌmo nehigenoꞌaeꞌmo Alifiꞌaepa avelegamo uno haino havaetale havaetale huno maiꞌniye.
Muki afinaꞌmo kotilamiyapiꞌmo muki vayaꞌmogimo geꞌamo afisayafeꞌmo agaetegamo ege ege huꞌa maiꞌnae.
